# Public-interest funding register

Program `1.0.0-rc.1` · Status: **proposed**. How to apply, review, and report is in the [program guide](README.md). The same data is published as searchable JSON at `/docs/funding/register.json`.

## Offers

| Offer | Status | Eligibility | Selection |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Donation | planned | Anyone may donate. Gifts that carry conditions beyond an area restriction are declined. | Donations join the pool of the next announced round in their area. |
| Recurring sponsorship | planned | Anyone may sponsor. Sponsorship buys no placement, ranking, seat, vote, or say in selection. | Sponsorship funds rounds in the sponsored area. Sponsors are listed as funders of the rounds they fund. |
| Targeted grant | planned | The area eligibility and general eligibility rules. | Disclosed reviewers score the published selection criteria. Awards go to eligible applications above the minimum score, in score order, within the pool and the concentration limits. |
| Matching | planned | The area eligibility and general eligibility rules. Matched contributions need public receipts. | Scored like a targeted grant. The award may not exceed the matched contributions times the ratio. |

## Areas and eligibility

- **Public repositories** (`public-repositories`): The repository is public, and anyone can read and clone it without an account. The code or content is under an OSI-approved or Creative Commons license. Where it is hosted does not matter: forkmesh.com, a self-hosted mirror, or another forge.
- **Volunteer mirrors** (`volunteer-mirrors`): The applicant operates a public mirror, relay, or gateway that people other than the operator have used for at least 60 days. The service publishes a health endpoint or status page.
- **Accessibility** (`accessibility`): The work improves a ForkMesh-compatible client, website, or document against WCAG 2.2 AA or the platform's accessibility guidelines. The plan includes testing with at least one person who uses assistive technology.
- **Documentation** (`documentation`): Public documentation, translations, or tutorials under an open license.
- **Education** (`education`): Courses, workshops, or learning materials about decentralized collaboration, under an open license and free to attend or read.
- **Ecosystem tooling** (`ecosystem-tooling`): An independent client, relay, index, verifier, or library with a public https source under an OSI-approved license. A certification badge is welcome but not required.

Every application must also meet these rules:

- Individuals, informal groups, and organizations in any jurisdiction the funder can lawfully pay may apply.
- Applying, being reviewed, and being paid need no ForkMesh account, plan, client, wallet, or token.
- The operator of forkmesh.com and people it pays are not eligible for awards.
- A round's funders and reviewers are not eligible in that round.
- Work whose use requires a paid plan on any ForkMesh-operated service is not eligible.

## Selection criteria

| Criterion | Weight | What reviewers score |
| --- | --- | --- |
| public-benefit | 30 | How many people outside the applicant benefit, and how directly. |
| feasibility | 20 | Whether the milestones, budget, and schedule are realistic for the applicant. |
| accessibility-inclusion | 20 | Whether the work serves people with disabilities, low bandwidth, or languages the ecosystem under-serves. |
| sustainability | 15 | Whether the result keeps working, or is handed on, after the award ends. |
| decentralization | 15 | Whether the work adds a new operator, region, implementation, or maintainer, and so reduces concentration. |

Reviewers score each criterion from 0 to 5. An award needs a weighted score of at least 60 out of 100, from at least 3 reviewers, of whom at least 1 is not a ForkMesh maintainer.

- Conflicts: A reviewer who is the applicant, or who shares an employer or funder with the applicant, must record a recusal and must not score that application. Any other conflict a reviewer declares is recorded and recused the same way. A funder never reviews, never chooses a recipient, and may restrict a gift only to an area.
- Concentration: at most 25% of a round's awards to one recipient. More than 50% to one area, or more than 50% of the pool from one funder, must be addressed in community review.
- Administrative cost: at most 10% of the pool. Administrative cost covers payment fees, accounting, and reviewer stipends. It is published per round before applications open.

## Payment rails

| Rail | Kind | Recurring | ForkMesh account or plan needed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bank transfer (SEPA, ACH, or international wire) | conventional | yes | no |
| Open Collective, through the recipient's own fiscal host | conventional | yes | no |
| Liberapay | conventional | yes | no |
| Solana transfer to an address the recipient controls | on-chain | no | no |

## Independence

An award, donation, or sponsorship pays for work. It never changes who can reach a repository, what an identity may do, who votes, or what the network requires.

Awards never grant: `repository-access`, `identity-rights`, `protocol-votes`, `governance-seats`, `ranking-or-discovery`, `moderation-outcomes`, `required-network-behavior`, `hosted-product-use`.

The only obligations an award may carry: `milestone-report`, `outcome-report`, `open-license`, `accessibility-statement`, `public-receipt`, `conflict-disclosure`.

### PIF-0001

**Pilot round: volunteer mirrors, accessibility, and documentation**

Milestone grants and matching for people who run public mirrors, make ForkMesh-compatible clients and documents accessible, and write open documentation. Recipients choose their own payment rail.

- Areas: volunteer-mirrors, accessibility, documentation. Offers: targeted-grant, matching.
- Payment rails: bank-transfer, open-collective, liberapay, solana.
- Apply through: An issue labelled funding-application on any forge mirror of forkmesh/forkmesh. Email to the address in the round announcement, for applicants who cannot apply in public.
- Timeline: announced —; applicationsOpen —; applicationsClose —; selectionsPublished —; finalReportDue —; reported —
- Pool: not published. Administrative cost: not published.

The round opens when:

- A funder commits the pool and publishes the amount, source, conflicts, and any area restriction.
- Administrative cost is published and stays within 10% of the pool.
- At least three reviewers with current governance disclosures are seated, and at least one is not a ForkMesh maintainer.
- The application window is announced with at least 21 days to apply.
